text:
marie (marketing): Quick checklist for Thurs customer demo — need final reg page, Zoom config, greenroom schedule, recording + transcript handoff. Who can own each?

dan (events): I can own Zoom & greenroom. Will set host/co-hosts and call times. Need the reg page field list and email copy.

aj (product): I’ll own the registration page template and UTM mapping. Minimal fields: name, email, company, role, country, opt-in checkbox. Also add a short prompt for use case (single-line).

marie (marketing): Perfect. For follow-up we need: confirmation email with calendar invite, replay link flow (recording -> s3 -> transcript -> short clip). HubSpot mapping: lead source=webinar, campaign=launch-q2, lifecycle=marketing-qualified.

dan (events): Zoom settings quick checklist: cloud recording ON, record active speaker + gallery, enable audio transcript (auto-transcribe), require registration, approval=auto. Also enable waiting room for greenroom minutes. For backup: local recording on producer laptop + OBS RTMP fallback to our ingest if cloud fails.

sam (producer): I’ll be at greenroom + local capture. Naming convention for files: "redwood-launch-YYYYMMDD-region-demo-ROLE.mp4" and transcripts as .vtt/.srt. Example: `redwood-launch-20260326-na-demo-host.mp4`.

aj (product): Small ask — PII in chat. We should disable file transfer and set chat to host-only during live to avoid uploads. Also add a slide at start with privacy note.

manual-note (zoom-bot): Reminder: enable "Allow cloud recording" in account settings and set alternative hosts as needed.

dan (events): For registration -> HubSpot routing: use Zapier webhook to push registrants to the webinar list, tag by country, and add to nurture flow. I'll post the Zap mapping later.

marie (marketing): Email cadence after event: Day0 thank-you + replay link, Day3 2-min highlights clip + case study CTA, Day10 deep-dive invite. Who can draft Day0 and Day3?

aj (product): I’ll draft Day0 (confirmation + replay). Marie — you take Day3 highlights CTA?

marie (marketing): Yup. Also: please share access to recordings in the #assets folder and flag any sensitive customer material before publish. Sam — confirm you can push to s3 and publish to staging by EOD Friday.

sam (producer): Confirmed. Will upload raw + edited files, add transcripts, and create short clips. I’ll also add captions SRT and generate a 2-min cut for Day3.

dan (events): Final ops checklist I'll post as a single pinned message: 1) Reg page live + test registrant, 2) Zoom settings applied, 3) Producer local backup confirmed, 4) Zapier mapping pushed, 5) HubSpot tags validated, 6) Post-event asset handoff.

marie (marketing): Awesome — if no objections I’ll mark owners and lock the schedule. Thanks team :rocket: 

sam (producer): One more note — do we want a separate caption-only transcript file for accessibility? I can generate .vtt and plain-text transcript.

marie (marketing): Yes please. Add both.

zoom-bot: Scheduled meeting created: "Redwood Launch Demo" Thu 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC. Host: dan. Recording: enabled."
